topic_detail: Holiday-table scenario: when you say you are doing a degree your family says 'proud'; he says the conveyor belt (degree, job, wedding, children, house) leads to a statistically 50 percent divorce and to debt; the average person gets average results and holiday tables should say 'no' to the average family.
audience: young adults and students facing family pressure, aspiring entrepreneurs
caption_vs_video_note: Caption ('השנה בשולחן החג, אומרים לא! למשפחה הממוצעת שלכם') matches the video's holiday-table scene and 'average' theme; it adds a hashtag block that the video does not show.

opening.s0_1: Same shot; captions 'אומר' then yellow quoted 'אני עושה תואר' (0.5-0.75 s).
opening.s1_3: 'בארוחת שישי' (1 s), 'הנה עכשיו חגים שואלים' (1.25-2.25 s).

opening.visual_hook: A podcast speaker who turns into a grey-haired grandmother via a filter overlay, a family-dinner skit inside the podcast clip.
opening.spoken_hook: Speech from 0 s matches the captions (machine transcript): 'כשאתה אומר אני עושה תואר בארוחת שישי, עכשיו חגים שואלים: מתן, מה אתה עושה?' then 'אתה לא עונה, אימא שלך עונה בשבילך' (3-4 s).
opening.text_hook: כי כשאתה אומר "אני עושה תואר" בארוחת שישי / הנה עכשיו חגים שואלים "מתן מה אתה עושה?"
opening.first_sentence_standalone: no: 'כי כשאתה אומר' starts with a conjunction (a mid-thought start); the situation is clear only after about 2 s

editing.edit_function: The wig overlay acts as a cheap role-play device for the relatives' quotes (humour and clarity); stock clips illustrate each milestone; animated charts present the divorce statistics; the timeline summarises the argument in one graphic.
pacing_changes: t=0-27 s: wig overlays and short captions
t=26-42 s: dense stock and graphics
editing.ending: Podcast: 'וכולם דוחפים אותנו לשם בצעקות בחג', then the club end card with an audience collage and 'כי מעל 2500 יזמים לא טועים!' (45-51 s).
editing.rewatch_reasons: interpretation: humour from the wig character and the shocking divorce chart; the end card is repeated across his Reels.

sound.delivery: Fast and animated, continuous at -13 to -20 dB, with a short drop at 31-34 s (-22 to -23 dB); the last 5 s is quieter (-28 to -37 dB) on the end card.
sound.sync: Captions in phrases; colour changes with the speaker (magenta for the imitated relative, yellow for his quoted line); stock clips on the nouns.

text.colour_coding: White main; yellow for his own quoted line, magenta for the imitated relative, orange for another quote, red for the harsh claims ('פס יצור', 'לחץ חברתי', 'סטטיסטית', 'לא לקבל', 'כדי לא לגמור').
text.style: Bold white sans-serif with dark outline, no box; coloured by voice.
text.density_and_read_time: One to four words per caption, changing about every second.
text.language: Dialogue-style quotes with a family voice, plain strong terms ('פס ייצור', 'לחץ חברתי'), statistics.
text.caption_structure: A one-line call 'השנה בשולחן החג, אומרים לא! למשפחה הממוצעת שלכם ✊' and about 13 hashtags.
text.rtl_notes: A red hyperlink-style label '^פס הייצור המזדיין^' has carets on the wrong sides; quotes are placed at wrong sides at several points.

story.setup: At the Friday dinner you say you are doing a degree; the holiday relatives ask what you are doing.
story.stakes: The pressure of the 'conveyor belt' leads to divorce and debt.
story.progression: Family answers for you; 'gold medal pride'; then what comes next, 'what now, who will bring children, buy a house'; there are stages, the conveyor belt; statistics: 49-50 percent divorce, 61-72 percent in the red; the average person does not get what they want; fat people and a laptop at home alone; everyone pushes us there in the holiday.
story.payoff: A statement that the average person is short of money by month end (about 'two salaries' in a garbled line at 35-38 s of the machine transcript), then stats on divorce, being in the red, obesity and loneliness; a say-no stance. The exact wording is unclear in the transcript at 35-38 s.
story.resolution: End card with a social proof number.
story.payoff_delivered: partly: the statistics are shown, the 'what to do instead' is not in the frames I read
friction_points: t=36-42 s: stock clips of fat people and a lone laptop user may read as mocking (interpretation)

engagement.comment_notes: Approximate hand count over 43 sampled comments plus replies. Praise ('סוף סוף מישהו אומר את זה', 'מדויק') and sharp disagreement from professionals (doctors, engineers need a degree; 'מי יחתום עליהם'); some focus on the family angle ('תלך לטיפול'). Not representative of 199 comments.
engagement.creator_reply_pattern: A heart emoji and a clapping and fire emoji to two accounts; the other replies are from third parties.

conversion.cta_fits_content: partly: the end card ties anti-conveyor-belt messaging to the club by implication

rights_and_privacy: Stock-looking clips (baby, house, a man eating, laptop) and silhouette footage of unknown licence; a second adult shown briefly; an end card with identifiable event attendees.
why_it_may_work: Interpretation: the wig role-play makes a heavy topic funny and instantly recognisable, the milestone timeline and divorce chart compress an argument, and the debate drives comments (199).
why_it_may_underperform: Interpretation: statistics are given without source and the claim 'no degree' triggers pushback.

standout_moments.what: Wig and glasses overlay turns him into a relative with the quote 'מתן מה אתה עושה?'.
Animated life-milestones timeline with the red label 'פס הייצור המזדיין'.
Divorce and debt bar charts over background clips.
